resources.string: Identify Line-In music playing in followed Living Room or Kitchen while the clock is visible. YouTube Music handles listening behind the clock display; the bridge reads the identified song and artist on this tablet. No API key or recognition subscription is needed.
YouTube Music bridge is ready. Farragut Clock does not need microphone access for this provider. The accessibility shortcut can stay off.
Enable “Farragut Clock — YouTube Music bridge” in Android accessibility settings. Return here to finish turning on automatic recognition. The accessibility shortcut is optional and can stay off.
The YouTube Music bridge is enabled and waiting to connect.
Couldn’t open accessibility settings. Open Android Settings > Accessibility and enable “Farragut Clock — YouTube Music bridge”.
